card.name: Symptoms and findings after 'develop' or 'signs and'
card.fires_on: The noun symptoms, findings or abnormalities right after 'signs or', 'symptoms and' or 'laboratory' in warnings about what to do if a patient develops signs of a condition.

modes.label: Symptoms after signs
modes.description: The word symptoms follows 'signs and/or' in a 'patients who develop' warning.
modes.example: patients who develop signs or<< symptoms>> of peripheral vasculopathy.

modes.label: Findings or abnormalities
modes.description: Findings or abnormalities follow 'symptoms and' or 'laboratory' before 'suggestive of'.
modes.example: patients who develop symptoms or laboratory<< findings>> suggestive of lactic acidosis or pronounced

card.writes: It favors words like 'associated' and 'suggestive-of' type continuations and suppresses 'noticed/observed' verbs.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a warning where a list of signs, symptoms or lab findings is about to be followed by 'suggestive of' a condition.
